# {{PROJECT_NAME}}

> An AponiaJS application: Nest-style modules, controllers, and dependency
> injection on Bun, with Elysia as the HTTP layer.

Working instructions for this repository, including its commands and authoring
rules, are in [`AGENTS.md`](AGENTS.md).

## Framework documentation

- [Architecture and style](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/main/docs/architecture-and-style.md): application layout, naming, and expected patterns
- [Modules and dependency injection](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/main/docs/dependency-injection.md): tokens, visibility, providers, and the error codes raised on failure
- [Controllers and routes](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/main/docs/learn/05-controllers-and-routes.md): declaring routes and reading request input
- [Validation](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/main/docs/learn/06-validation.md): route schemas and one-schema-per-class validation models
- [WebSocket gateways](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/main/docs/websockets.md): the message envelope and gateway lifecycle
- [Native Elysia plugins](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/main/docs/native-plugins.md): mounting a plugin and typing what it adds
- [Errors](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/main/docs/learn/10-errors.md): the closed error-code union and HTTP problem responses
- [Elysia compatibility](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/main/docs/elysia-compatibility.md): which Elysia versions this framework supports
- [Devtools](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/main/docs/devtools.md): the loopback API an enabled registration serves, and what it does not report
- [CLI reference](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/main/docs/cli.md): the full schematic catalog, aliases, and options
- [Learning path](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/main/docs/learn/README.md): the same material as ordered chapters

## Packages

- [@aponiajs/common](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@aponiajs/common): decorators, descriptors, tokens, and errors
- [@aponiajs/core](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@aponiajs/core): module graph and dependency injection container
- [@aponiajs/platform-elysia](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@aponiajs/platform-elysia): bootstrap, HTTP routes, WebSocket gateways, and typed HTTP errors
- [@aponiajs/cli](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@aponiajs/cli): the `aponia new` and `aponia generate` commands
- [@aponiajs/devtools](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@aponiajs/devtools): the opt-in loopback devtools an application adds, which this starter leaves out
